outputs.explanation: Scatter plot showing 141 individual sample measurements as distinct markers colored/shaped by subtype; marginal histograms also show underlying distribution. Individual data points are directly plotted.

This is a scatter plot of mean ± s.d. per reporter/cell line (n=6 samples averaged per point, or n=3/n=5 in some cases). Only the mean with error bars is shown; the individual replicate measurements underlying each averaged point are not overlaid.
Line plot showing fitted normal/gamma distribution density curves of subtype-averaged periods and amplitudes. Line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Boxplot of CWT ridge lengths with individual sample data points (Per2-Luc and Bmal1-Luc dots) overlaid on each box.
Polar histograms showing averaged phase-difference distributions per cell line; histograms are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Polar histogram averaged by subtype; histograms are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Line plot of an example raw signal trace with fitted decaying sinusoidal model; this is a single illustrative example, not an average of multiple samples, so individual points are not applicable.

Scatter plot where each of the 117 individual samples is plotted as its own marker (color/shape coded by subtype/cell line), with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty per point; individual measurements are shown.
